amazon.gate_window: Claude's call 2026-11-05, Steve to overrule: FBA window Oct 1 to Apr 30 (no cold chain). May to Sep: FBM from Vosges' Chicago facility with cold packs (the DTC operation already ships that way), not a pause, so rank and reviews survive the summer.
amazon.ticket_ceiling: Claude's call: 35 dollars for the snackfection line. Single 8.99 pouch does not clear the FBA waterfall; architecture is a 3-pouch set near 26.99 and a 5-flavor variety set near 40 (the nudge pack, read against the leaders per rule 17 step 5). Boxed gifting is its own lane with a 75 dollar ceiling.
amazon.posture: Brief for Andy and Jay (CEO, COO) first; client-run vs us vs agency decided after the brief. Vosges is not on Amazon today; the case is built from the competitors (presence, floors, ladders, review counts).
amazon.note: Amazon lane is separate from retail: own blocks folder, own data folder, own report. Rows are candidates for amazon_comps (manual audit), never retail_entries. Nine-step checklist per SOP v82 rule 17.
amazon.always_on_sku: Red Fire Hearts (solid molded 62% dark, no fill, heritage flavor). Backup: Matcha Bites (72% dark, solid). Pink Salt and Dulce de Leche (caramel fill) inside the window only.
amazon.parity: Amazon never undercuts Whole Foods or Faire on the 1:1 pouch; a single pouch, if listed, is 10.99 or higher.
